description: Angular component for displaying and interacting with properties in a viewer, including filtering, user options, and property tree visualization.

classes.name: PropertiesComponent
classes.description: Angular component for properties view with filtering and user options.

methods.name: filterTree
methods.description: Dispatches an event to filter the properties tree based on filterString.

methods.name: updateTree
methods.description: Dispatches an event to update the properties tree based on user options.

methods.name: showNode
methods.description: Determines if a node should be shown based on whether it is a Terminal.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if a node is a leaf in the properties tree.

methods.name: itemIsSelected
methods.description: Checks if a property item is selected.
